english.note: Use this as the all-purpose equivalent for intense, uncontrolled emotional excitement or panic.

examples.english: The whole stadium erupted in hysteria when the goal was scored.
examples.traditional: 入波嗰刻，全場球迷都歇斯底里咁大叫。
